info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Initiation API
info.description: The Payment Initiation API enables businesses to facilitate the seamless initiation of payment transactions within their banking systems. This service allows users to submit payment requests efficiently, ensuring quick processing and confirmation. Typical consumers include financial institutions and third-party applications that require an interface to initiate payments on behalf of their customers. By streamlining payment initiation, this API enhances user experience and operational efficiency in financial services.

post.summary: Initiates a payment process in the servicing system.
post.description: This operation allows users to initiate a payment within the servicing system, ensuring that all necessary information is provided for processing the payment securely and efficiently.
